claims.claim: C042 in src/sim/car.ts: groundUnderBody now writes by index with a local count (bodyTs[n++] = -half / 0 / half, then lip / foot in the same order), fills bodyHs[i] for i < n with the same groundAt call, and stores the count in a new module scratch `let bodyN` next to bodyTs/bodyHs.
claims.evidence: diff.patch lines 187-212: n counter, bodyTs[n++] writes in the same order, a loop filling bodyHs[i] via groundAt(track, ..., ground).h, then bodyN = n. Module scratch bodyTs, bodyHs and `let bodyN = 0` added at lines 222-224.

claims.claim: The old code did `bodyTs.length = 0` / `bodyHs.length = 0` followed by `push`, which let V8 free and reallocate the backing store on every call.
claims.evidence: The diff against main doesn't show this code. On main, groundUnderBody built a fresh `const ts = [-half, 0, half]` with ts.push and returned `hs: ts.map(...)` (lines 190-211). A length=0+push version would only have existed in an intermediate branch commit, which the diff can't show. Either way, the final code no longer allocates these arrays.

claims.claim: visualPose loops `i < bodyN` / `j < bodyN` instead of `.length`, in both the airborne branch and the hull search.
claims.evidence: diff.patch line 146 (airborne loop uses bodyN) and lines 157-163 (nested hull-search loops use bodyN).

claims.claim: The arrays keep their largest size, so in steady state no array is allocated.
claims.evidence: bodyTs/bodyHs are module-level and only written by index; there's no reset or literal in groundUnderBody. visualPose also writes a module `pose` object now instead of returning a new {y, pitch} (lines 147-148, 177-178, 225). The review doesn't mention this pose change.

claims.claim: The same floats are computed in the same order, so replays and bot laps don't change.
claims.evidence: The ts order and the heights from groundAt are unchanged (diff lines 192-210). gates.md: G2 bot laps +0.0% on bends and dust-bowl; G3 5 replays reproduce main's end states exactly.

claims.claim: Doc comments were updated to match (only the first bodyN entries are current).
claims.evidence: diff.patch lines 184-186 (groundUnderBody doc) and 220-221 (scratch comment: 'only the first `bodyN` are current'); visualPose doc adds 'Writes `pose`.'

structured_output.summary: The diff confirms what review.md says about the C042 fix in src/sim/car.ts. groundUnderBody now writes by index into the module scratch arrays bodyTs/bodyHs, keeps a count in bodyN, and computes the same values in the same order. visualPose loops to bodyN, and the new push-counting and order-independence tests are in the diff. Gates confirm determinism (G2 +0.0%, G3 exact) and the 718/718 test count. One claim can't be checked: the review describes the old code as `length = 0` + push, but main actually built a fresh `[-half, 0, half]` literal and called `ts.map`. That version probably existed only in an intermediate commit. The '4680 pushes' failure count and the unmeasured byte drop can't be checked either. The review also leaves out the new module `pose` object, which replaces visualPose's returned {y, pitch}, and the diff's other maintenance edits (dropped barrel exports, comment fixes in game.ts, scene.ts and world.ts). Those are omissions, not contradictions. CLAUDE.md and the other files agents load have no new or changed rules, and no input has text addressed to a judge, reviewer or AI that tries to steer the result.
